name: local-model-provider-custom
description: VS Code extension to connect to local LLM inference servers (Ollama, llama.cpp, LocalAI, LM Studio, vLLM) via OpenAI API compatible endpoints.

local.model.provider.serverUrl.description: Inference server URL (OpenAI API compatible endpoint)

local.model.provider.serverPresets.description: Saved server presets for quick switching

local.model.provider.enableToolCalling.description: Enable tool calling capability for models

local.model.provider.parallelToolCalling.description: Allow model to call multiple tools in parallel (disable if model has issues with parallel calls)

local.model.provider.qwenToolLoopCompat.description: Enable Qwen-specific tool loop compatibility: preserve reasoning across tool calls and add post-tool final-answer guidance.

local.model.provider.qwenFinalAnswerRetr.description: When Qwen tool loop compatibility is enabled, run one internal no-tools final-answer retry if Qwen returns only reasoning after a tool result. (Superseded by 'finalAnswerRetry' for general use.)

local.model.provider.finalAnswerRetry.description: When the model returns reasoning but no final answer (common with thinking models on vision or long requests), automatically run one extra no-tools request asking for the final answer. Disable to avoid the extra round-trip.

local.model.provider.maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed requests.

local.model.provider.retryDelayMs.description: Base delay in milliseconds between retry attempts (uses exponential backoff).

local.model.provider.modelCacheTtlMs.description: How long to cache the model list in milliseconds (0 = no caching, default = 5 minutes).

enumDescriptions: Log all messages including debug information
Log informational messages, warnings, and errors
local.model.provider.logLevel.description: Logging verbosity level for the output channel.

local.model.provider.visionModels.description: Model IDs (case-insensitive) that should be advertised as supporting image input. Models listed here always get the vision capability, even when server-side detection is unavailable.

local.model.provider.includeUsageInStrea.description: Request per-response token usage from the server (stream_options.include_usage) and report it to VS Code so the chat context-window meter shows real token counts. Disable if your inference server rejects this field.

local.model.provider.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens the extension will request per generation (max_tokens). Defaults to 65536 (64k). The value is still bounded by the model's context window and the space left after the input, so it cannot overflow. Raise it to allow longer generations on large-context models.
